Review Content: All the doctors & staffs are great & professionals! Send my precious baby there and got admitted to the clinic for almost 2 weeks due to a very serious illness. All of them, did their best to take good care of my cat, Yoda and didn't gave up on him. Special thank to Dr Aidil for doing a great job assisting Yoda ensuring he will get better every day until today. Thank you so much passionvet !

My dog has been receiving acupuncture here for over a year. After trying acupuncture at several vets, he showed the least resistance at Passion Vet. Dr Kerrie is skilful and calm, and my dog consistently feels more comfortable with his mild hip dysplasia after each session.Treatments started weekly and were gradually reduced to monthly as his condition improved. There was no pressure to sign packages or buy medication. The nurses are friendly and genuinely caring.When my dog needed his first cone due to paw chewing, the entire staff came out to applaud him to help him accept it. To this day, he loves wearing a cone, something that continues to puzzle our dog's boarder and daycare staff.The passion and dedication of the team truly stand out, well done!

My dog Akimi has been visiting Passion Vet's Dr Kerrie since she was a puppy. Dr Kerrie is always our first-to-go-to vet for Akimi. We love the passionate team working here, always gentle, patient, friendly and serving with a heart.

I sent my cat when he was at a critical stage, with death being almost imminent. After sending My cat to the vet, he was hospitalised, and came back like he had 9 lives. Thank you PassionVet for bringing back my cat to life

My first visit to Passion Vet and everything went so smoothly --- from making the appointment via WhatsApp to the actual visit. They even sent a reminder message to confirm the appointment, which was really helpful. Dr. Kerrie was very patient with my dog during his yearly vaccination. She noticed he was nervous and even gave him treats to help him relax. Really friendly and caring service!

I had a change of vet for my senior cat and i'm glad i did. Thanks to my sister and her cat volunteer friends for recommending Passion Vet. Else i wouldn't even know Caramel is having diabetes or worse wasting my time cos the previous vet was beating around the bush. The prev vet recommended me separate blood test for Caramel when i could have done all that in a day at Passion Vet. Blood test with thyroid test and urinalysis. If it wasn't for Dr Thaz and team at PV i would be stressing myself out about my cat. Caramel also been having constipation issues since he was a baby and Dr Thaz and team helped to really take good care of Caramel while he was hospitalized there. With his diabetes and constipation issues at hand i was ready to let Caramel go because i didn't want to see him suffer. But Dr Thaz, Dr Aidil and all the nurses didn't give up on Caramel. With his insulin and daily fluid therapy i can see Caramel is looking so much better. His fur even looks better than before. Also with his freestyle libre on, i am at ease knowing what his glucose reading is at different times of the day. Thank you to the team at Passion Vet for your patience and dedication to saving the animals.

Been bringing my kopi boy to them for a few years. Usually for ear infection, pancreatitis, yearly vaccination and recently did an Allergic testing with them.The doctors have no airs and friendly with the down to earth vibe. Prices are reasonable for my opinion and the team is quite okay hence I usually return to them. Front desk staffs are Helpful n polite too.

Doctors and the nurses are knowledgeable and helpful. The doctors explained everything clearly and made me feel at ease. My Twinkle is recovering well and is back to her usual self. I am so glad that she is no longer coughing anymore and much better compared to before treatment.

I have been bringing many of my rescued cats to Passion vet for many years for various illnesses. The vets at this clinic are very compassionate and caring when treating the cats.Their service is excellent and I am deeply grateful for their wonderful services tended to them when the cats are ill.Many of my cats have recovered and are doing very well.No matter how difficult and fierce my cats are, they handle very efficiently and manage them very well. Those stressful cats are also handled very well to make them comfortable.I will definitely recommend Passion vet for their excellent and passionate services tended to all those pets which comes into their care attention.

Had a bit of an issue procuring prescription ointment from our primary vet, so we reached out to PassionVet. Maisarah (receptionist) was kindly enough to help secure it after navigating both sides, and we are most appreciative for her and the clinic's help :)

My cat had a spay surgery here, and the doctor Kerrie was very professional, friendly, and patient.However, the front desk staff was unprofessional. I made an appointment a month in advance, but a few days before the scheduled surgery, I did not receive any reminder. When I contacted them, they told me there was no appointment in the system, which caused the surgery to be delayed by another month.Also,the staff was not very friendly.The five stars are entirely for doctor Kerrie!

I rushed in with my bird after a nail accident, and although the clinic mainly handles dogs and cats, Dr. Thazmeer immediately stepped up. She was calm, kind, and confident, explained everything clearly, and managed to stop the bleeding like a miracle with first aid. I'm grateful for her compassion and professionalism --- the clinic is lucky to have her!From William Chua, pet named "happy" after my late dad.
Extremely professional and friendly staff, very experienced and friendly Dr Kerrie Lek ! I highly recommend this vet, I am always assured that my puppy coca is in safe hands ! 10 stars 🌟

Milo was admitted due to urinary blockage. And he was taken care under Dr Aidil and team. I appreciate that whenever Dr Aidil updated me on the situation, he did not rush when he explained. He was compassionate, firm and calm. The calmness helps anxious pet owners like me who are already worried about their sick pet. I could slowly digest and process on everything he said. I want to thank Dr Aidil and team of nurses for taking care of Milo till his last breath. 🌈🌸

Hazel is suffering from vestibular disease and she is unable to balance, walk, drink and eat. Hazel is getting much better now and she can walk, drink and eat by herself after one week 🙏. I google and found out it needs few weeks to show ...

Was attended by Dr. Aidil and nurse Intan. Did a thorough yet quick evaluation of my shy boy Puma and he was surprisingly comfortable with them! As he mostly tries to evade Drs and nurses alike. Glad to have brought him here! Thank you once again team for making it a pleasant trip over!
Dr Kerrie and her team are very friendly and patient towards my dog in getting her used to the injections with the hypoallergenic dog treats. Thank you for taking good care of my pooch :)
Thank you Dr Kerrie and Dr Aidil for caring for beibei! They are accurate with providing the suitable treatment for her symptoms, and we are seeing great results 🙏

Thank you Dr. Kerrie! My senior dog was diagnosed with cataract at a local animal eye specialist, and surgery was recommended. Mine is a senior dog, I was hesitant after my friend's dog which is the same age as mine, didn't wake up from surgery. It broke my heart to even think about it. A colleague recommended Dr. Kerrie, I visited, she prescribed some eye drops for my dog, and I'm amazed at the improvements after a month or so! My dog can now see treats better than before. Highly recommend this clinic and staffs there are super friendly too! (No bill shock XD)

Had the first visit for my cat Carter with Dr Kerrie. She was detailed and assuring, and gentle in handling. Glad I decided to come here for my cat's vaccination. Highly recommended. Friendly front office, too.

I have been bringing my 7-year-old dog for acupuncture sessions with Dr. Kerrie for over a year now. Recently, my 8-year-old dog also started acupuncture due to neck pain from spinal nerve compression. Dr. Kerrie has been incredibly attentive and caring to both of my dogs. She clearly explained the benefits of acupuncture during our first visit, and her expertise and compassion have made a significant difference in their well-being. I highly recommend Dr. Kerrie for anyone considering acupuncture for their pets.

I recently visited a vet who truly stood out due due compassionate and kind approach. Dr Aidil was not only sympathetic and gentle with my pet but also made sure to explain each step of the examination, ensuring I was comfortable and informed. What impressed me most was their honesty and integrity; they recommended only the necessary procedures, avoiding any unnecessary treatments or expenses. This diligence and dedication to the well-being of animals showcased their professionalism and care. I highly recommend this vet to any pet owner who seeks a trustworthy and caring professional for their beloved animals.<3

Read many great reviews about them online. Dropped them a text via the number provided on their website to enquire on their consultation, lab tests and radiology charges. Shortly after, I received a phone call from their clinic staff asking about my fur baby's condition. Despite being advised not to wait until the following day to seek for immediate medical help due to my pet's condition, they were kind enough to arrange the earliest slot the next day. Unlike any other vets I have been to, the services rendered by Passion Vet could be felt.My cat was attended by Dr Kerrie and his condition were explained in detail for better understanding. In times of distress, Dr Kerrie and the counter staff have been comforting through out our time there. They have been patient to answering any of my queries when in doubt and costs are within reasonable range compared to other places.Thank you Passion Vet for nursing Cloudy to health!

We took our 6 month old hamster to see Dr Kerrie on 28 May 2022 for a wound growing on her stomach. Apart from the fact that it's difficult to find a vet that can operate on hamsters, Dr Kerrie was very calm and professional with her, performing the op successfully and trying to answer any follow up questions we had with her afterwards.Dew made a full recovery within the year and passed peacefully on 25 May 2024.Would like to thank Passion Vet and Dr Kerrie for giving Dew a larger chance at life.
Friendly staff, send daily updates upon request like photos and videos, took very good care of my puppy!

Took my two kittens for their first checkup and vaccinations at this vet clinic. Dr. Kerrie provided friendly and attentive care, and my kittens remained calm during the injections. Additionally, received a complimentary Kitten Kit. The staff at the registration counter was also friendly.

I've been with Passion Veterinary the past 1.5 years for a stray cat. Dr Kerrie Lek is very knowledgeable about her work and passionate about her job. She educates me about the condition of the cat in detail, patiently assesses the cat and explore treatment options with me. She baby talks to my community cat which I love and is tender and loving towards the cat. I lack in veterinary knowledge but not once has she judged me for it but have affirmed me that I am doing enough for the cat. Once, I had to go to the nearest coffee shop to use the bathroom and I left the cat in a carrier outside the clinic as I did not want to occupy the tiny clinic space. When I came back I found my carrier inside the clinic and learnt that it was Dr Kerrie who moved my carrier inside as she was concerned that the cat may get dehydrated from the warm weather. This shows she is proactive and has genuine care for animals.Their prices (esp accupuncture charges) is also one of the most affordable in sg I think.I would 100% recommend Passion Veterinary. I believe my community cat agrees with me. She deserves way more than 5 stars as it is evident that she gives 110% to her job.

Thank you Lynn for her great service.Your efficiency and friendliness made our visit so much smoother, and your assistance with the paperwork and answering my questions was incredibly helpful. It's clear you take great pride in your work and genuinely care about the clients. Thank you Lynn for making our experience at the clinic a positive one.😆😆😉

I was impressed with Dr Kerrie's gentle care and knowledge when attending to my consultation (05/04/2024) with a comm cat (batman) that was injured. Also, the customer svc provided by the clinic was very gd! As it was an emergency, I had ...

The doctor Marc here is very helpful and nice. He very patient when we were asking our questions because we are new to taking care of kittens. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic as he will no doubt ensure the very best for both you and your pet.
